title: Hydrodynamic Analog of the Klein Paradox: Vacuum Instability and Pair Production in a Linear Elastic Medium
summary: The Klein Paradox -- the anomalous scattering of relativistic fermions off a high potential step -- signals the limit of the single-particle interpretation of the Dirac equation. While Quantum Field Theory (QFT) resolves this via pair production, the microscopic mechanism is often obscured by abstract formalism. In this work, we investigate this phenomenon through the framework of Analog Gravity and Condensed Matter Physics.
